Name: SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge
Author: SonicWall
Description:
The [SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge](https://www.sonicwall.com/products/cloud-secure-edge) (CSE) solution ingests CSE events into Microsoft Sentinel through the CSE events API, and includes a parser, a workbook, analytic rules, and hunting queries for CSE sign-ins, private access, device trust, and Internet Access.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

a. [Codeless Connector Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)

b. [Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview)
